jobs.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: Vietnamese historical RTS map cutout sheet. Image 1 is the edit target and determines each object and its layout; image 2 is the drawing-style reference ONLY. Match the accepted Đông Hồ style: warm-black carved contours, large opaque ochre/vermilion/indigo/leaf-green pigment shapes, sparse curved decorative marks, no gradients, tiny hatching, photorealistic shading or engraved microtexture. Preserve the original silhouettes, identity and functional shapes. No labels, grid lines or scenery. Keep the ten original plant species and spring season cues. Read order: round tree, jackfruit, lychee, pomelo; silk-cotton, grass tuft, bamboo, banana; areca palm, banyan, empty, empty. Large leaf masses with a few curved leaf marks, full trunk/root contacts, no soil patch or cast shadow. Keep deciduous/evergreen distinctions from the original. Landscape 1536x1024, 4 columns by 3 rows, 10 occupied cells in reading order. At least 24 pixels of empty margin around each complete silhouette and wide gutters. Use genuine transparent alpha including every hole, without a painted checkerboard. If true alpha cannot be produced use one exact #FF00FF production matte instead, including holes. No paper rectangle, white background, cast shadows, or magenta inside subjects.

Match the accepted Đông Hồ contours and sparse carved curves, with flat opaque pigment.
